desc:
🚗 Run your own car wash! Customers pull in, you drive their car into the bay, blast the dirt off and hand it back shining.

🆕 AUTO WASH UPDATE: open your own auto wash behind your plot! Build up to four lines, upgrade them, and watch the cash roll in while you wash.

🫧 Foam it, rinse it, scrub the wheels, wipe the glass, clear out the cabin and change the tyres
⭐ Every car earns you a grade and cash: cleaner and faster pays more
🔧 Level up to unlock new tools and new jobs, then upgrade them
🏎️ Collect all 40 cars, from everyday Sedans to LEGENDARY Supercars
🏠 12 garage styles, from bare block walls to a penthouse
✨ And now and then, a car covered in glitter or slime

4 players per server, each with a workshop of their own.

Cash register sound: "Cash Register" by kiddpark on Freesound, CC BY 4.0, trimmed.
